name: Genis
text:
Forwarded from the gym desk
The squeegee went missing from lane 3 again. Spares are in the cupboard and the club kit list is with Genis.

name: Speil-Ehrenreich
text:
Fwd: Water pressure
The third floor taps lost pressure on Tuesday and the pump room was checked the same day. The valve was stiff and has been freed, the pressure is holding overnight. If it drops again ring Speil-Ehrenreich.

name: La Brooy
text:
Forwarded from the print room
The wide format roll came in damaged on one edge, so the supplier was sent photos and a replacement roll is on its way. Jobs due this week were printed on the narrow machine. The order number is on the delivery note by the shelf, and any offcuts go to La Brooy.

name: Marija-Magdalena Francescantonio
text:
Forwarded from the choir
Rehearsals shift to the church hall while the school is painted. Robes are in the vestry. The music folders are with Marija-Magdalena Francescantonio.

name: Satheeskumar
text:
Fwd: Fence panels
The storm took two panels down along the back path and the posts may need replacing too. A temporary barrier is up and the wood has been ordered. The quote is pinned in the shed, chase Satheeskumar for the exact date.

name: Narancic
text:
Forwarded from the ticket office
Season tickets go on sale next week and the box office window opens at nine sharp. Members get the first two days as usual. The counters will run until close on both days. Volunteers should collect their lanyards from Narancic before the rush.

name: Merhan Djumali
text:
Fwd: Delivery delay
The window frames for the new build arrive a week late, so the glaziers have been moved to the other site. New dates are with Merhan Djumali.

name: Forastiere Schökle
text:
Forwarded from the front desk
The parcel pile in the lobby is being cleared Thursday, so unclaimed items go to the store at noon. Anything with a name tag stays on the shelf until Friday. The courier pickup sheet is signed by Forastiere Schökle.

name: Ruairí
text:
Fwd: Field trip
The bus leaves at half seven and returns around six, weather dependent. Packed lunches are needed as the canteen is closed for the day. Spare waterproofs are in the office if anyone needs them. The consent slips all came back, confirmed by Ruairí.

name: Neitzert
text:
Forwarded from the allotments
Plot inspections start Monday and the list is on the gate. Water butts must have lids. Any questions go to Neitzert.

name: Metkel Smith
text:
Fwd: Kitchen deep freeze
The freezer failed its check on Thursday and the stock has been moved to the spare unit. The seals were the weak point and a repair is booked for Tuesday. The temperature chart is on the clipboard, initialled by Metkel Smith.

name: Enji Soukeina
text:
Forwarded from the workshop
The bench drills are out for calibration until the end of the month, so the hand tools are back in use for small jobs. The schedule is on the wall with the pickup dates. Mark the battery packs with tape before they leave the room. The sign out book is kept by Enji Soukeina.

name: Roa
text:
Fwd: Bus route
The 14 stops at the top of our road until the bridge reopens. Timetables are in the shelter. Ask Roa about the school run timing.

name: Eriol
text:
Standup 9:30
Bay four changeover is on schedule and the tool trial passed.
Safety note about the new ramp was read out.
Open items: the label printer and the paint order.
Next check is with Eriol.

name: Meneau
text:
Quality meeting
First article inspections passed on both runs and no concessions were raised this week.
The gauge set is booked for recalibration on the 12th.
Supplier scores are due Friday, draft is ready for review.
The minutes go out once Meneau signs them off after the review panel.

name: Nouel Ancrum
text:
Housing meeting
Repairs list trimmed to nine jobs and the fire door top of the queue.
Budget note deferred to March.
Lease checks signed by Nouel Ancrum.

name: Sekularac Nwoke
text:
Volunteer briefing
Three new helpers were shown the till and the alarm panel.
The summer fete stall plan is nearly done.
Donations sorting moves to the back room from next week.
Cake stall is with Sekularac Nwoke.

name: Idalia
text:
Planning call
The outline for phase two was agreed and the drainage report is the next gate.
Consultation dates stay as they are, the hall is confirmed for both nights.
The model file was updated with the new plot numbers.
The action list is with Idalia.

name: Boufidis
text:
Lab huddle
Incubator two is out of service until the part arrives.
Sample backlog cleared.
Rota swaps go through Boufidis.

name: Ilango Neuburg
text:
Facilities sync
The chiller repair is booked and the alarm test moves to Friday.
Two quotes for the roof survey came back and the cheaper one covers more.
Parking bay markings refresh starts after half term.
Sign off at the gate went to Ilango Neuburg.

name: Efi Lajde
text:
Garden team notes
Tomatoes in the far beds need tying in before the weekend and the greenhouse vent is sticky again.
The seed order arrived short and the missing packets are on backorder.
Compost deliveries run every second Wednesday.
Tool shed key is held by Efi Lajde.

name: Lieta
text:
Reading group
The next book is out of print, so copies are in the blue crate.
Meet at the cafe instead.
List is with Lieta.

name: Represa
text:
Allotment committee
The path repairs are done and the skip goes back Monday.
Plot 12 gets its new tenant from the waiting list.
Water rates stay the same this year.
Letters drafted by Represa.

name: Raffray de Haller
text:
Budget review
Software costs came in under forecast and the training line needs topping up for the new starters.
Travel is on hold until the new policy lands.
The printer lease is up for renewal in June and the quote is low.
Final sign off is with Raffray de Haller.

name: Uthaya Klijn
text:
Shift handover
Press two ran short of guards so it was stopped for an hour.
Pallets counted twice.
All keys back with Uthaya Klijn.

name: Musiari
text:
Warehouse briefing
Aisle ten is blocked for the floor repaint until Thursday.
The new trolleys arrived and the old ones go for scrap.
Night team starts an hour early on Friday.
Fresh batteries for the scanners are with Musiari.

name: Dymitr
text:
Fwd: Night cover
The boiler check for the weekend is confirmed and the rounds sheet is on the office door. If the alarm trips, ring the duty line first before anything else. Spare torches are in the drawer by the till. Anything unusual gets written in the book.
Thanks,
Dymitr

name: Chantziaras
text:
Fwd: Keys
Two sets were cut for the new starters and tagged with their desk numbers. The third set stays at reception.
Thanks,
Chantziaras

name: Al Anwar
text:
Forwarded from security
The gate camera was realigned on Monday and the recording window is back to thirty days. Two badges were handed in found in the car park. The lost property box is behind the desk.
Regards,
Al Anwar

name: Jurko Tilevska Berrani
text:
Fwd: Roof lights
The skylight seals on the east side are being replaced over two days next week. Access is from the mezzanine so clear the pallets under the hatch by Sunday night. The crew brings sheeting and the floor will be protected. Report any drips after the work to the building office.
Best regards,
Jurko Tilevska Berrani

name: Mejda
text:
Fwd: Canteen
Soup is back on the menu from Monday and the card machine is fixed. Hot food runs until two.
Thanks,
Mejda

name: Truppa
text:
Forwarded from the labs
Sample racks are being relabelled this week, so the old numbers may not scan. Use the handwritten number on the side until the new labels settle. The log sheet on the bench catches up each evening.
Thanks,
Truppa

name: Indemburgo Cannoletta
text:
Fwd: Van service
The service is booked for Wednesday and the courtesy van is reserved for the school run. Remove the roof bars before Tuesday night and leave the fuel card in the glovebox. The garage will ring if anything extra shows up on the ramp. Mileage was recorded at the last fill.
Regards,
Indemburgo Cannoletta

name: Ramajana Bahia
text:
Fwd: Uniforms
The new fleeces arrived and sizes run small, so try before swapping. The returns box is by the staff room door.
Thanks,
Ramajana Bahia

name: Wisal
text:
Forwarded from the caretakers
The bin store lock is fixed and the new key is on the hook in the office. Cardboard collections move to Thursday for the next month. Please flatten boxes before stacking.
Thanks,
Wisal

name: Barmes
text:
Fwd: Room bookings
The training room is held for the audit team all next week, so internal sessions move to the library annex. Bookings already in the diary have been reissued with the new location. The projector in the annex needs a dongle, one is in the desk drawer. Tea and water are on the honesty tray.
Kind regards,
Barmes

name: El Rifaï
text:
Fwd: Seed swap
The spring seed swap is on the 16th in the village hall. Bring labelled packets and a box to carry swaps home.
Thanks,
El Rifaï

name: Amora Pfister-Roth
text:
Forwarded from the pool
The chlorine reading was high on Tuesday so the pool was closed for an hour and retested. Everything is back within range and the log is initialled. Lessons run as normal this weekend.
Thanks,
Amora Pfister-Roth

name: Haleema
text:
Programme board
Milestone two slipped a week because the cabling contractor was double booked. The revised dates are on the wall chart and the client has been told. Risks list updated with the access issue on site. Actions were read back before the room emptied.
Thanks,
Haleema

name: Acero
text:
Toolbox talk
Harness checks were demonstrated and two worn lanyards were taken out of service. Signatures collected on the sheet.
Thanks,
Acero

name: Hyett Notev
text:
Inspection round
West stairwell cleared and the handrail fix confirmed good. Fire doors all close fully, one closer needs adjusting. Bins were moved off the escape route. No other issues raised on the walk.
Thanks,
Hyett Notev

name: Josette Mongérard
text:
Supplier review
Delivery times held steady and the two damaged pallets were credited without argument. The new contact is faster on email than the old one. Pricing stays fixed until the summer. Next review is booked for the end of the quarter. Notes filed with the contract.
Thanks,
Josette Mongérard

name: Zaheer
text:
Parking group
Two visitor bays move to the north row from Monday and the permits list is updated. Towing starts in June.
Thanks,
Zaheer

name: Djennane
text:
Rota planning
Bank holiday cover is sorted and the swap requests are all answered. The summer schedule draft has two gaps in August. Overtime stays capped at the usual level.
Thanks,
Djennane

name: Sá Pinto
text:
Culture club
The gallery trip is booked for the last Saturday of the month and the coach leaves at nine. Tickets are ten each, pay at the desk by Wednesday. The lunch stop has been moved to the riverside cafe. Bring a rain coat just in case.
Thanks,
Sá Pinto

name: Münhan Sikila
text:
Fire drill
Assembly point confirmed at the far car park and the sweepers were named. Roll call took four minutes.
Thanks,
Münhan Sikila

name: Ranim
text:
Garden club
The raised beds are ready and the soil delivery lands Friday morning. Tools need a wipe down before they go back in the store. The water butt tap was replaced.
Thanks,
Ranim

name: Bissinger
text:
Vendor call
The migration window is agreed for the weekend and the rollback plan was walked through. Two staff will be on standby from six on Saturday morning. The test tenant stays live until Sunday night. Notes and the runbook link went out after the call.
Thanks,
Bissinger

name: Talija Yishan
text:
Cleaning review
The stairwells passed the spot check and one corridor light needs a new tube. Deep clean dates are confirmed.
Thanks,
Talija Yishan

name: Junger Piron Plankenhorn
text:
Board summary
Quorum was met and the minutes from the last meeting were approved. The roof fund sits at target and the fence quote was accepted. Next meeting moves to the second Tuesday. Draft minutes held.
Thanks,
Junger Piron Plankenhorn
